changelog: **Outbound approval inbox (#2960, `docs/outbound-approval.md`):** a per-organization setting `outboundApproval` (`off` | `lead_mail`, default `off` everywhere, MARKETING vertical only — the settings API refuses it elsewhere) holds automated mail to the org's leads, customers and account-less contacts for an operator. One pure rule (`src/lib/outboundApprovalRule.ts`, unit-tested) lists every mail category with its reason: the essential `account_security` group (including the double-opt-in `consent` mail, but not the cron-driven `retention-reminder`, which is held) and the person's own acknowledgement stay exempt, the org's ADMIN/MENTOR staff are never held, an unknown category is held. The one hook sits in `sendEmail()` between `prepareEmail()` and the dispatch: a held mail is stored as a sealed `OutboundDraft` (new table, tenant-registered, de-duplicated per org by the mail's key), `EmailLog` records the new `HELD` status, and `sendEmail()` answers `'HELD'` so cron claims stamp and no draft is rebuilt. `/admin/outbox` (admins) and `/sales/outbox` (sales reps, own leads only) list the drafts with a sandboxed preview and send now / schedule / discard, singly or in bulk (`/api/admin/outbox/**`, each decision one guarded `updateMany` from `DRAFT` plus an AuditLog row); approval hands the mail to the mail queue with idempotency key `draft:<id>`. A mail too large for the queue cannot be scheduled but is sent inline on "send now"; a held newsletter copy settles out of `HELD` once approved. Undecided drafts expire on the hourly mail tick, decided ones are pruned after 30 days (retention entry `outboundDraft`), and account / contact erasure removes them. The nav link carries a pending-count badge and the new `withoutCapability` tag; the authz matrix probes another tenant's draft from every role.

en: New outbox for sales teams: switch on approval in Settings and automated mail to your leads and customers waits for you — preview each one, then send it now, schedule it or discard it.
tr: Satış ekipleri için yeni giden kutusu: Ayarlar’dan onayı açın; müşteri adaylarınıza ve müşterilerinize giden otomatik e-postalar sizi beklesin — her birini önizleyin, sonra hemen gönderin, zamanlayın ya da silin.
de: Neuer Postausgang für Vertriebsteams: Schalten Sie die Freigabe in den Einstellungen ein, und automatische E-Mails an Ihre Leads und Kunden warten auf Sie — Vorschau ansehen, dann sofort senden, planen oder verwerfen.
